idle.title: A quiet experiment
idle.description: A patient blink and a small smile. Quiescent: playback runs in Core Animation with no state timer.

inspect.title: Hold it to the light
inspect.description: She checks the flask, smiles at the result, then returns to neutral.

tiptoe.title: Precious cargo
tiptoe.description: Four selected contact and passing poses alternate the raised boot, while her flask stays upright. Bounded motion is supplied by the engine.

watch.title: Something interesting
watch.description: A curious glance toward the pointer, followed by a neutral recovery.

greet.title: Hello, field researcher
greet.description: Lower the flask into its belt loop, free her palm for a wave, then retrieve it through the same transfer poses.

settle.title: Just one more chapter
settle.description: Bend the knees, lower the flask to the floor, then settle with the book on her lap. Dedicated sitting poses replace the landing crouch.

read.title: The book can wait
read.description: Read and blink using the exact seated endpoint of the sit-down sequence; quiescent in the native app.

sleep.title: A well-earned pause
sleep.description: Six sleeping poses: a slow inhale, a soft exhale and a deeper nod over her book. Her feet stay planted; the root’s leaves settle with her.

wake.title: Back to the experiment
wake.description: Gather her feet, retrieve the flask from the floor and straighten her knees. Reverses the sitting poses into the canonical neutral stance.

held.title: Mind the glass
held.description: Six airborne poses: knees tuck and boots swing gently while she hugs the flask and book. A quick blink gives way to a cautious smile.

fall.title: Feet first
fall.description: Six feet-first poses: boots adjust for landing while hair, apron and leaves catch the air. Floor contact interrupts the loop immediately.

land.title: Everything intact
land.description: Compress, exhale, and recover to standing before returning to idle.
